components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Carbon-ink button for the one main action on a sheet.
components.css: .ds-btn { min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 20px; border: 1.5px solid #1c2a66; border-radius: 2px; background: #1c2a66; color: #eef5f0; font: 700 16px/1 'Archivo Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-stretch: 104%; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn:hover { background: #111b4a; border-color: #111b4a; } .ds-btn:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1c2a66; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Line Button
components.css: .ds-btn-line { min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 20px; border: 1.5px solid #1c2a66; border-radius: 2px; background: transparent; color: #1c2a66; font: 700 16px/1 'Archivo Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-line:hover { background: rgba(28,42,102,0.07); } .ds-btn-line:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1c2a66; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Stamp Button
components.description: Cancel and deactivate actions in stamp red.
components.css: .ds-btn-stamp { min-height: 34px; padding: 5px 12px; border: 1.5px solid #b02a1d; border-radius: 2px; background: transparent; color: #b02a1d; font: 700 14px/1 'Archivo Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-stamp:hover { background: rgba(176,42,29,0.07); } .ds-btn-stamp:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1c2a66; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Ruled Field
components.description: Caption above a ruled baseline; no box.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; } .ds-field span { font: 650 12px/1.4 'Archivo Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-stretch: 82%; letter-spacing: 0.09em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #3c4a83; } .ds-field input { min-height: 40px; padding: 6px 2px; border: 0; border-bottom: 1.5px solid #5d7c6e; background: transparent; font: 400 17px 'Archivo Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; color: #1c2a66; } .ds-field input:hover { border-bottom-color: #3c4a83; } .ds-field input:focus { outline: none; border-bottom-color: #1c2a66; box-shadow: 0 1.5px 0 #1c2a66; }

components.name: Time Slot Chip
components.description: Cut-paper tile for picking a time; fills with ink when chosen.
components.css: .ds-slot { display: inline-grid; place-items: center; min-width: 96px; min-height: 36px; border: 1px solid #5d7c6e; border-radius: 2px; background: rgba(238,245,240,0.85); font: 600 15px 'Archivo Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; color: #1c2a66; cursor: pointer; position: relative; } .ds-slot input { position: absolute; opacity: 0; } .ds-slot:hover { border-color: #1c2a66; } .ds-slot:has(input:checked) { background: #1c2a66; border-color: #1c2a66; color: #eef5f0; } .ds-slot:has(input:focus-visible) { outline: 2px solid #1c2a66; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Status Stamp
components.description: Rubber-stamp status; form differs per status (dashed scheduled, solid confirmed, double completed).
components.css: .ds-stamp { display: inline-flex; padding: 2px 8px; border: 2px solid currentColor; border-radius: 3px; color: #b02a1d; font: 800 12px/1.5 'Archivo Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-stretch: 75%; letter-spacing: 0.13em; text-transform: uppercase; transform: rotate(-2.5deg); } .ds-stamp--scheduled { border-style: dashed; } .ds-stamp--completed { border-style: double; border-width: 4px; padding: 0 6px; }

components.name: Letterhead Navigation
components.description: Brand in expanded caps, role tabs with an ink underline when active.
components.html: Secure ClinicMy visitsBook a visitRecords
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 12px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #3c4a83; font-family: 'Archivo Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nav strong { margin-right: auto; font-weight: 800; font-stretch: 125%; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #1c2a66; } .ds-nav a { padding: 8px 12px; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; color: #3c4a83; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav a:hover { color: #1c2a66; border-bottom-color: #a3b8ad; } .ds-nav a.is-active { color: #1c2a66; border-bottom-color: #1c2a66; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1c2a66; outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview:
Every screen is a sheet of the clinic's own security stationery. The ground is pale mint safety paper with a faint guilloche field. All text is carbon-blue ink. Forms are ruled lines rather than boxes, and sheets carry a microprinted border rule. Booking means filling a slip and tearing off its stub along a perforation. Statuses land as rubber stamps.

The security of the product is shown the way security paper shows it: in the material. Guilloche, microprint, serials and seals are the decoration, and each one also says "this document is controlled". Explanations of the real security controls ride on thin red leader lines pinned to the exact field they protect.

Density follows the screen's job. The public landing page is generous and lets the booking slip lead. The role screens (visits, appointment book, accounts, audit log) are ruled ledgers: tight rows, tabular figures, one ink colour.
keyCharacteristics: Mint safety paper with a guilloche field, never white cards on grey.
One ink (carbon blue) for all text and rules; stamp red is reserved for stamps, security notes and errors.
Ruled form lines, perforations, microprint and serial numbers as the structural vocabulary.
Self-hosted Archivo with its width axis doing the hierarchy: expanded for letterhead, condensed for printed labels.

rules.name: The One Ink Rule
rules.body: Text and rules are carbon blue. Success messages are ink too; the only second hue on a page is stamp red (stamps, pinned notes, errors) or void grey (cancelled).

rules.name: The Stamp Is Pressed, Not Painted Rule
rules.body: Stamp red appears as outlines, small type and hairlines; never as a large filled block.

rules.name: The Width Axis Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy comes from width and weight in one family, not from a second typeface. Expanded means "issued by the clinic"; condensed means "printed caption".

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Times, dates, serials, fees and counts always use tabular figures.

rules.name: The Paper Only Rule
rules.body: Depth comes from sheets of paper and nothing else: no glass, no glow, no hard offset blocks.

dos: Do put every surface on a sheet of safety paper (sheet-mint with the guilloche tile) on the safety-mint ground.
Do use ruled baselines (1.5px, form-rule-strong) for inputs instead of boxed fields.
Do show status with a stamp whose form differs per status, not colour alone.
Do pin security explanations to the exact field they protect, and only state controls that exist in the code.
Do self-host fonts and assets; the Content Security Policy allows fonts and scripts from the app's own origin only.
donts: Don't put a small caption or kicker line above a heading; form codes belong beside the serial or in the sheet's small print.
Don't use stamp red as a background fill or for decoration.
Don't add a second typeface; vary Archivo's width and weight instead.
Don't animate anything beyond the stub tear and the stamp press.
Don't use white cards, glass, glow or hard offset shadows.
